item.title: DRC Ebola outbreak becomes deadliest in country's history
item.description:
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spread to a sixth province as the overall death toll surpassed 2,100 and cases topped 4,500. Experts say the virus may have been transmitted undetected for months, while health workers have struggled to contain the outbreak with poor medical supplies and no approved vaccine for the new strain — though several are in the works.
